a: Ku Ssande ey'omuzira ku makya, nga 6 Jaanwali 1850, Spurgeon eyali aweza emyaka kkumi n'etaano yasindikibwa kibuyaga w'omuzira mu kapeela katono aka Primitive Methodist mu luguudo Artillery, mu Colchester. Omubuulizi eyali alondeddwa teyatuuka olw'omuzira, kale omubuulizi omugonvu atali muweereza eyawongebwa n'alinnya ekituuti n'ekyawandiikibwa kimu kyokka, «Mutunuulire nze, mulokolebwe, mmwe enkomerero z'ensi zonna» (Isaaya 45:22), era bwe yasimba amaaso ku mulenzi eyali afaanana obubi, n'aleekaana nti: «Omuvubuka, tunuulira Yesu Kristo. Tunuulira! Tunuulira! Tunuulira!» Spurgeon yatunuulira, era nga bw'akyogera yennyini, ekizikiza kyaggwaawo mu kaseera ako. Yabatizibwa mu ttoggo eryo mu mugga Lark, ng'afuuse Omubatisita ow'okukkiriza okunywevu.

q: Kituufu nti teyasomera ku ttendekero eddene wadde ettendekero ly'abaweereza?
a: Kituufu. Spurgeon yasoma kitono mu masomero ag'omu Essex n'ekiseera kitono mu Newmarket, so nga abasumba ab'ettutumu ab'omu kiseera kye baalungisibwanga mu Oxford ne Cambridge. Kye yalina mu kifo ky'ekyo kwe kwali okujjukira okw'ekitalo n'ekitabo ky'ebitabo ebya Kipuritaani eby'omu nnyumba ya jjajjaawe ey'omusumba mu Stambourne, gye yasomeranga n'obwegendereza, ng'akyali mulenzi, Bunyan, Baxter, Owen ne Watson. Yatandika okubuulira mu kkanisa z'ebyalo ebyetooloola Cambridge ng'aweza emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, era n'afuuka omusumba wa kapeela katono aka Waterbeach ng'akyali muvubuka.

q: Omuvubuka ow'omu kyalo yatuuka atya okubuulira enkumi n'enkumi mu London?
a: Mu 1854, ng'aweza emyaka kkumi na mwenda gyokka, Spurgeon yayitibwa mu kapeela ka New Park Street mu London, ekyali kya byafaayo naye nga kikendedde, era nga wayise wiiki ntono ekizimbe kyali tekisobola kugyamu bibinja. Ekibiina kyasenguka mu Exeter Hall, oluvannyuma mu Surrey Gardens Music Hall ennene, era mu 1861 mu Metropolitan Tabernacle eyali ezimbiddwa mu Newington, eyagyamu abantu nga enkumi ttaano, gye yabuulira emyaka amakumi asatu egyaddirira. Wiiki ku wiiki ebibuulwa bye byawandiikibwa mu nnukuta enkumpanya ne bikubibwa, ne bitwala eddoboozi lye wala nnyo okusukka London.

q: Mukyala we Susannah yali ani, era Ensawo ye ey'Ebitabo yali ki?
a: Spurgeon yawasa Susannah Thompson mu Jaanwali 1856, era abafumbo ne bazaala abaana abalongo, Thomas ne Charles, bombi abaayingira oluvannyuma mu buweereza obw'Ekikristaayo. Wadde nga mu bulamu bwe obusinga yali mulwadde atatera kuva mu kisenge, Susannah yaddukanyanga okuva mu kisenge kye eky'obulwadde Ensawo y'Ebitabo eyateeka ebitabo eby'eby'okusinza mu ngalo z'abasumba abaali baavu nnyo okubigula, ng'agaba enkumi n'enkumi z'ebitabo mu myaka egyo. Yalabirira Charles n'obwesigwa okutuusa ku nkomerero yennyini ey'obulamu bwe.

q: Waliwo akabi akaali kumpi okukomya obuweereza bwe ng'akyali muto?
a: Ku lw'eggulo lya 19 Okitobba 1856, Spurgeon eyali aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu ebiri bwe yali akulembera abantu nga omutwalo mu kusaba mu Surrey Gardens Music Hall, abaleeta oluyombo baaleekaana mu bulimba nti omuliro gukutte era nti ebifo eby'ebbanga bigwa. Tewaali muliro, naye mu kudduka okw'amaanyi okugenda ku nzigi abantu musanvu baabetentwa ne bafa era abalala bangi ne balumizibwa. Spurgeon yaggyibwa ku kituuti ng'awangulwa ennaku, era okumala ekiseera abamu baatya nti teyandiddamu kubuulira; yawona mu wiiki ntono, naye ekiwundu tekyawona ddala.

q: Spurgeon ddala yalwanagana n'okuggwaamu amaanyi mu mutima n'endwadde z'omubiri?
a: Yee, era teyabikweka. Okuva ku kabi k'e Surrey Gardens yalwanagana n'okukubwa okuddiŋŋana okw'ekyo kye yayita «okuggwaamu amaanyi okutaliiko nsonga», era omubiri gwe gwakoowa olw'endwadde y'amagumba, obulwadde bw'ennyingo, era ku nkomerero obulwadde bwa Bright. Mu kifo ky'okukweka okubonaabona okwo, yakwogerako mu lwatu, era n'atuuka okukkiriza nti okubonaabona kwe kwafuula okubuulira kwe okuwoomerera abaamenyese emitima era ne kuleeta okubudaabudibwa eri abantu abatabalika abaabonaabona nga bwe yali.

q: Spurgeon yategeeza ki bwe yayogera ku «nnyumba y'amaanyi» ey'ekkanisa ye?
a: Abagenyi bwe bajjanga nga basuubira okuyiga ekyama ky'obwogezi bwe, Spurgeon teyabatwalanga ku kituuti wabula wansi mu kyoolelo, ebikumi n'ebikumi by'ab'ekkanisa gye baafukamiranga mu kusaba nga buli kukuŋŋaana tekunnatandika. Ekisenge ekyo yakiyita ekyoto ky'omuliro eky'e Tabernacle era yakitwala ng'ekivuga ekituufu eky'obuweereza bwe. Bwe yabuuzibwa ekyama ky'obuwanguzi bwe, yaddamu nga bwe yamanyiira nti abantu be baamusabiranga.

q: Mirimu ki egy'olubeerera gye yazimba okwongera ku kubuulira kwe?
a: Mu 1856 Spurgeon yatandika Ttendekero ly'Abasumba okutendeka ababuulizi abaali, nga ye, tebalina bisobozi bya kusoma kutuufu, era yasomesa n'ayamba bangi ku bo ye kennyini. Mu 1867 Ennyumba y'abaana ab'enfuuzi ey'e Stockwell yaggulwawo, ng'etandikibwa oluvannyuma lwa nnamwandu Omwangalikani ayitibwa Anne Hillyard okuwaayo ssente nnyingi ng'addamu okwegayirira kwe ku lw'abaana abataliiko bakitaabwe; era yatandikawo ekibiina ky'abatambuza ebitabo okutwala ebitabo eri abaavu, n'alongoosa akatabo ka buli mwezi Ekitala n'Ekyasi. Yanywereza nti ekisa kye yabuuliranga kiteekwa okukolerwa mu mirimu egy'okusaasira.

Mu 1887, ng'atiisiddwa olw'okuserengeta wakati mu basumba abamu Ababatisita okuva ku kussibwamu omukka kw'Ekyawandiikibwa, okutangirira okw'okudda mu kifo kyaffe, n'amazima g'omusango, Spurgeon yavuga endulu mu lukalala lw'ebiwandiiko ebimanyiddwa ng'oluyombo lw'«Okuserengeta». Mu kifo ky'okukkiriza ebitali bimu, yeeyawula ku Baptist Union, olwo n'olumunenya mu bululu, era oluyombo lwamuggyako emikwano era, nga bangi bwe bakkiriza, lwayanguya okuggwaamu amaanyi kwe. Obuyinza bw'Ekigambo kya Katonda yabutwala nga busaanira buli muwendo gwonna.

q: Yafa atya era wa, era yaleka ki emabega?
a: Ng'akooye olw'obulamu obw'omulimu n'obulwadde, Spurgeon yanoonya obuweerero mu mpewo ennungi ey'e Menton ku lubalama lwa Bufalansa, era eyo n'afiira nga 31 Jaanwali 1892, ng'aweza emyaka amakumi ataano mu musanvu. Yaleka emabega ebibuulwa ebifulumiziddwa ebisukka mu enkumi ssatu mu bitaano, nga bikyali mu mirimu egisinga obunene egy'omuwandiisi Omukristaayo yenna, awamu n'ebitabo ebyagalwa nga Eterekero lya Dawudi, Byonna Bya Kisa, ne Ebyokusomesa Abayizi Bange. London yamukungubagira nga omulangira, emitwalo n'emitwalo gy'abantu ne bayita ku ssanduuko ye, era Bayibuli ye eyali eyanjuluze yali egalamidde ku yo.
